scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

correction.finding_closed: Mailbox::return_value now rejects every terminal value with EBUSY while exec.pending(), before check_return, copy, begin_return or response.take. The separate RET0 completeness gate remains intact.
correction.delta: One unconditional pending guard; coupled helper, ledger and protocol files unchanged.

actual_evidence.observed: Compilation and all five body tests exited 0; direct children joined, groups absent, streams closed, no timeout or capture/retirement error.
actual_evidence.new_case: Pending negative RET cannot invoke its copy closure or publish; response, descriptor and section claims remain held. Stale worker/delivery ABORTs fail. Exact ABORT permits negative RET; claims remain until publication, then quiescence succeeds and the response contains -14.
actual_evidence.regressions: Four existing cases pass with only the two pending RET0 expectations changed from EINVAL to EBUSY.
actual_evidence.compiler_stderr: Three retained unused-import warnings: VecExt, AtomicU32 and ResponseOwnedExecClaims. Test stderr is empty.

preservation: Original source finding, original four-case PASS and prior ledger acceptance remain valid historical records.
limits: Eligible for subsequent separately authorized integration/build checks. Actual UserSlice success/fault execution, whole-module ABI compilation, full-crate compilation, linking, default activation and native behavior remain unproved.
provenance: Independent read-only review of exact correction and retained raw results; no edits or executions. Dispatcher records this decision with reviewer attribution.
